Mission Local reported in September 2023 that SF State was planning broad staffing reductions amid a budget deficit and enrollment below its target. The article said lecturers were facing the largest cuts, with reductions amounting to about 30% for most colleges; it also reported proposed cuts equivalent to 23 tenure-track faculty positions and six staff positions. The story noted that the number of lecturers affected was unknown.

The article’s correction clarified that SF State was 16% below its target enrollment—not that enrollment had dropped by 16%.
